# House of Singh

> House of Singh is the creative world of Maninder Singh — a multidisciplinary designer, photographer, and creative director based in Toronto, Canada. The work spans design, photography, and intentional living.

## Who is who

Maninder Singh, RGD, is a Toronto based designer, photographer and creative director. He works under the name House of Singh (houseofsingh.com), his creative practice and parent brand, active since 2014. HOUSE OF SINGH is a registered Canadian trademark (TMA1179828). He led the TEDxToronto creative team.

House of Singh Studios (studios.houseofsingh.com) is his design studio for brand identity, websites, photography and creative direction, founded in Canada on 8 September 2023. It is a venture of House of Singh.

House of Singh and House of Singh Studios are not affiliated with other businesses that use similar names.

Maninder Singh works under the moniker House of Singh, creating design and photography rooted in restraint, material honesty, and a sense of place. This site is his portfolio and journal.

## Main pages

- [About](https://houseofsingh.com/about): The story, values, and vision behind House of Singh, including Maninder Singh's background, milestones, and a personal rapid-fire Q&A.
- [Projects](https://houseofsingh.com/projects): Selected work across design, photography, and creative direction, filterable by category.
- [Journal](https://houseofsingh.com/journal): Thoughts, process notes, and behind-the-scenes stories.
- [Contact](https://houseofsingh.com/contact): Inquiries for projects, collaborations, and media features.
